terra.problem: The dough-and-recipe comparison does not match the action in the parable or explain why the split matters.
The comparison changes having no extra oil into having no dough at all. The lamps have oil and are later going out.
The virgins went out to meet the bridegroom, not because of their lamps.
The text says the foolish virgins took no extra oil. It does not say they had no flasks.
The text does not say the wise virgins had five flasks.
The text does not say the bridegroom is not there when they talk. The cry has already announced, ‘Here is the bridegroom!’
‘Nobody knows’ goes beyond Jesus’ statement that his listeners do not know. Matthew 24:36 says the Father knows.
